response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals), telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), kept AS (SELECT t.* FROM telescope_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.avg_pulse_rate), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - o.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - a.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_second_average FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN second_average a WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > a.avg_pulse_rate
